note: Salvage classification of the Clara agent/ runtime + tool registry (frozen repo @ ac0a684f). Consistent with verified findings in findings/*.json (Grt, Ggr, H, I, E, D, GAPS, A, B, C, F3, F12) and maps/agent-map.md. PORT = proven, carry largely as-is; REBUILD = right idea, rebuild to the named standard; DROP = do not carry.

items.reason: Wrong: a POSTed chat run executes ONLY inside a subsequent SSE attach, so fire-and-forget callers (Documents tab) silently never run (D-1/E-1 critical); no per-scope run lease (GAP4-2), no cancel verb and Stop never aborts the 40-turn write-capable loop (GAP4-4 high); 150MB bodies fully buffered on a 1GB VM (E-7); bootstrap routes silently drop attachments (E-11). Rebuilt shell must enqueue durable runs executed independently of any SSE consumer, CAS a per-scope run lease with typed 409, expose a real cancel that aborts before the next tool call, and stream/bound request bodies — while keeping the proven verify-then-IDOR auth order, exact error taxonomy, and honest webhook 202.

items.reason: Wrong at the core: 100% process-local run state (every in-flight run, parked clarify, interruption dies on restart — Grt-1/6/7/8 high), runs execute only when an SSE consumer attaches (D-1/E-1 critical), unknown needsApproval interruptions silently auto-approved (fail-open, Ggr-11/GAP0-2), clarify answers uncorrelated to clarifyId or asking user (GAP4-3 high), clarify uploads REPLACE the parked attachment batch causing evidence aliasing (GAP5-6 high), wake deadline races but never cancels the loop so late writes land after 'failed' (agent-map note 6), and SDK platform tracing ships every firm's data to OpenAI's trace store by default (GAP1-8 high). Rebuilt runtime must be DB-durable (tasks/runs/checkpoints/interruptions/tool-calls), execute independently of stream attach, deny-by-default on unknown interruptions, correlate + persist clarify Q&A, use immutable sha-addressed attachment refs, propagate real cancellation into the SDK loop, and make tracing an explicit owner-approved policy defaulting off. Worth carrying: the deterministic je_needs_human short-circuit pattern (Grt-14) and the firm-binding of runIds.
